title: Polynomiality of the natural invariant anticanonical index
exact_target: Let a compact real torus T act holomorphically on a compact complex manifold F and linearize $L=-K_F$ by the differential action. Put $I_T(m)=\Sigma _q(-1)^q$ dim $H^q(F,L^m)^T$. Must some positive a and rational polynomial P satisfy $I_T(m)=P(m)$ for every positive multiple of a, with $P(0)=I_T(0)$? No positivity or projectivity is assumed.

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
